outcome.technical: _floor_guard.py: a Python test file counts as compared only when (changed lines of each copy) minus (lines of its units) minus (lines of the tree's inert additions) is empty; otherwise it is listed under notRead as could-hold-one, with the first leftover line named (`_unaccounted`). Changed lines come from an ordered SequenceMatcher diff of the two copies' statement pieces (depth + ast.dump, a compound statement by its head), so comments, layout, docstrings and skip reasons are no change. `_statements` walks every statement once, giving each a chain: the generic `_head` of every enclosing statement (built from the node's own fields, no statement-kind list) plus each body's pytestmark. Units (test defs, or labelled checks in a file with no collected test) are found wherever they stand and compared with their chain: same text plus a different chain is the finding 'is unchanged, but a statement enclosing it is not'. Checks pair exact, then label+args, then label, then args+chain (a rename); a check called through another callee is gone. Inert means: a new unit; a new module/class-level def or class whose name the base mentions nowhere, undecorated, not hook-named (`_HOOK`); a module-level import/assignment binding only unmentioned names; a statement after the last base unit of its function, or after every statement of a function holding none (non-hook functions only); in an added file, everything except hook-named or decorated non-test defs. An addition that holds an existing unit is never inert. Rule 4: `_still_a_test` - a move pairs only to a path of the same family that every test reading of the old path (name, directory) also makes a test, otherwise TEST_DELETED. Rule 5: `_declaration` - path::case covers only when exactly one base unit answers, otherwise a note in the finding says the case is ambiguous. Rule 6: SKIPS gains `raise SkipTest` and `importorskip`. After the first measurement, one fix: which reading a file gets (definitions vs labelled checks) is decided only by tests the runner collects, i.e. none enclosed by a function (`_collected_tests`). Nested helpers named `tests_of`/`tests_edit` in test_audit_task.py had flipped that file to definition mode, losing every check comparison in 16 commits; fm63 was red on this before the fix. outcome.descriptive: The floor guard now calls a Python test file compared only when every changed line is inside a compared test or check (read with everything enclosing it) or an inert addition, and names the first line that is not.
